# Mentally Prepare
Anonymous 21-night pen pal journaling for adults (18+). One matched stranger
in your region, one honest note each night, unlocked the next morning.
On night 21 both people choose whether to reveal identity; one "stay
anonymous" choice keeps both private. Free during early access.
Not therapy, counselling, or crisis care.

Safety: https://mymentallyprepare.com/safety
Privacy: https://mymentallyprepare.com/privacy
